{{Quote|This prison is far more dangerous than we originally thought&hellip; and far older. Many of these vaults were constructed thousands of years before the Republic came. Imagine the secrets inside.|Master Sergeant Korum|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Korum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Korum was stationed in the [[Minimum Security Section]] and was tasked with opening the various [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vaults in the area, but he lost thirty men trying to capture the [[vault K-66]] when the Rakata war [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the vault attacked them. Korum sought other Imperial aid in deploying reprogramming spikes to the droids, allowing the Empire to control them.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Sergeant Korum appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he provides Imperial players with the mission "Catalyzing the Conversion."<ref name="TOR" />
